findings.body: The expected bytes retain checkout line endings. With `core.autocrlf=true`, the [Git for Windows default](https://github.com/git-for-windows/build-extra/blob/main/installer/install.iss), these Markdown files contain CRLF: `.gitattributes:1–2` only pins two JSON files to LF. However, `src/forge/sync.py:246` normalizes newlines when reading and `src/forge/sync.py:146` writes LF bytes. Consequently, the assertion at line 53 fails on the first installation even when sync preserves its previous behavior. The suite includes Windows runners (`.github/workflows/forge-next.yml:23–25`). Construct expected bytes using the established LF output convention while retaining the byte comparison.
findings.title: Not done: byte-for-byte install test passes on Windows
